messages:
emily: Quick logistics Q  offers go out today, what canonical link should I paste so hires across LATAM/EMEA/APAC find the recording later (not the ephemeral Meet link)?
rohan: Use the calendar event URL as canonical (we attach the recording + quick-watch there). Example: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nh-orient-main-2026. After the call we also publish a single shortlink bundle (slides + 20m quick-watch + transcript).
claire: Can someone add a tiny timezone table to the top of the calendar description? New hires in IST/AEST often import .ics and create duplicates. A clear table helps.
ops-bot: Added timezone table and bold note to event description: "IMPORTANT: If you accepted via Google Calendar, DO NOT import the .ics (it can create duplicate events in Outlook/Apple)." Per-region TZ-fixed .ics available on request.
emily: Nice. Two quick follow-ups: 1) will the recording include chapters/timestamps so folks can jump to Security/Infra/Product? 2) who do I ping for the shortlink?
rohan: Yes  we produce chapters and a trimmed 20m "quick-watch" with timestamped chapters (Security @ 00:14:40, Infra @ 00:28:10, Product @ 00:41:00). Chapters and SRT captions are attached to the calendar event and stored in Drive:/onboarding/recordings. Ping @rohan for the shortlink and I'll publish it within 30m of processing.
accessibility: Accessibility note  we auto-generate EN captions and SRTs and run auto-translations. For verified human captions/translation or live ASL, DM me names/language at least 48h in advance and we'll arrange for the replay.
claire: Also: APAC replay? A bunch of hiring managers want to include that in offers for east-coast Asia starts.
ops-bot: APAC replay event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nh-orient-apac-2026 at 09:00 AEST on 2026-06-08. Invited new-hires@redwood.com.
emily: Perfect  I'll paste the calendar event URL in offers and say "Slides + recording (full + quick-watch) attach to the event within 30 minutes; if you can't attend, watch the quick-watch and join the weekly drop-in Q&A." Thanks all.
rohan: Thanks  if any new hires report timezone/duplicate issues, have them DM the event id and local TZ and ops will produce a TZ-fixed .ics for their region.
